preconditions.description: L and R are integers where 1 ≤ L ≤ R ≤ 10^6

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.strip() == 'YES' and all(line.strip() != '' for line in stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: Output is either 'NO' or a valid 'YES' response with a complete city description

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and (lambda lines: (len(lines) >= 3 and all(len(line.split()) == 3 for line in lines[2:])))(stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: If 'YES', the output must include n, m, and m lines of road descriptions with exactly three integers per line

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and (lambda lines: (2 <= int(lines[1].split()[0]) <= 32 and 1 <= int(lines[1].split()[1]) <= int(int(lines[1].split()[0]) * (int(lines[1].split()[0]) - 1) / 2)))(stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: If 'YES', n must be between 2 and 32, and m must be within the valid range for n

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and (lambda lines: all(1 <= int(a) < int(b) <= int(lines[1].split()[0]) for line in lines[2:] for a, b, _ in [line.split()]))(stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: If 'YES', all roads must connect blocks with valid indices (1 ≤ a < b ≤ n)

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and (lambda lines: all(1 <= int(c) <= 10**6 for line in lines[2:] for _, _, c in [line.split()]))(stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: If 'YES', all road lengths must be positive integers ≤ 10^6

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and (lambda lines: len(set((a, b) for line in lines[2:] for a, b, _ in [line.split()])) == len(lines[2:]))(stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: If 'YES', there must be no duplicate roads between the same pair of blocks

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and (lambda lines: (lambda n, m, roads: all(1 <= a < b <= n for a, b, _ in roads) and all(1 <= c <= 10**6 for _, _, c in roads) and len(set((a, b) for a, b, _ in roads)) == m))(int(lines[1].split()[0]), int(lines[1].split()[1]), [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in lines[2:]]) and (lambda n, m, roads: (lambda L, R: (lambda paths: all(L <= d <= R for d in paths) and len(paths) == R - L + 1))(L, R, [sum(c for a, b, c in roads if a == x and b == y) for x, y in [(1, n)]]))(int(L), int(R), [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in lines[2:]])
postconditions.description: If 'YES', the constructed city must be (L, R)-continuous: all paths from block 1 to block n must have lengths between L and R inclusive, and there must be exactly one path for each length in [L, R]
